errorExplainer.sensitivity.markdownDescription: How trigger-happy the explainer is, from **Zen** (0 — stays quiet until an error is clearly real) to **Nitpicky** (100 — speaks up early and often). Higher values also start covering warnings and info hints.

errorExplainer.patience.markdownDescription: How long to wait for an error to stop changing before explaining it, in milliseconds. Errors flicker while you type, so a little patience avoids noise. **Instant** is 0; **Deep zen** is 5s.

errorExplainer.narration.markdownDescription: How much hand-holding in explanations, from **Pro** (0 — terse: what it means and the fix) to **Baby** (100 — spells everything out, with reassurance).

errorExplainer.contextLines.markdownDescription: How many lines of surrounding code are sent along with an error to make the explanation better. 0 sends just the error line — nothing extra leaves your computer.

enumDescriptions: Automatically, once an error stops changing for a moment.
Only when you save the file.
Only when you ask (hover or right-click → Explain this error).
Free hosted explanations (we pay the bill). Best quality, zero setup.
Built-in library only: instant, free, works offline. Covers common errors only.
Local AI via Ollama: private, code never leaves your computer. Needs a decent machine.
Your own API key: for people who already have one.
errorExplainer.source.description: Where explanations come from. The built-in library and cache are always tried first.

errorExplainer.statusBar.description: Show a connected / offline indicator for the core in the VS Code status bar.
